build_GAN_module: build a PyTorch Lightning GAN module with generator, discriminator, and adversarial loss criterion
train_GAN_generator: train the GAN generator by computing generator loss against discriminator output
train_GAN_discriminator: train the GAN discriminator by computing loss on real and fake images
configure_GAN_optimizers: configure Adam optimizers for both generator and discriminator with shared learning rate
initialize_GAN_weights: initialize Conv and BatchNorm layer weights using normal distribution
